newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA NOT TO HAND LAMA INTERNATIONAL BAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA NOT TO HAND LAMA INTERNATIONAL BAN.

text.p: World soccer governing body FIFA has decided against an international ban on France goalkeeper Bernard Lama after he tested positive for cannabis.
FIFA said on Friday that it was a decision of the French national federation to ban Lama for five months in May for playing for his club Paris St Germain.

"FIFA is not going to make it an international ban. Legally it is a matter for the national federation and it must decide whether he is banned or not," FIFA official Gerhard Mayer-Vorfelder said after a meeting where the case was discussed.
It also appears that if Lama, who tested positive in February, were to leave France and move abroad, FIFA would be unlikely to intervene. It would also remain a matter for the national federation.
Lama was handed a five-month ban, three months of which were suspended. He is believed to have had offers from clubs in Spain and England.
